title: UAAP: Diassana stands tall as Bulldogs regain form, add to Tigers’ woes
summary: National University returned to the win column after holding off University of Santo Tomas, 75-71, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
